name: Equinox Hour draws a card (observed missing self-banish cost)
notes: Equinox Hour's element is NORM, so no lineage patch is needed, and its memory cost (0) needs no floating-payment setup. This fixture documents a real implementation gap found while authoring it: the card text reads 'Banish CARDNAME: Draw a card...' but activateAbilityAbilities['UE6g95C1nZ:0'] (GeneratedMacroCode.php) only calls Draw()+EquinoxHourResolve() -- there is no prereq function and no case in GameLogic.php's ActivatedAbilityCost() switch for this card, unlike Charged Manaplate/Beastbond Paws which correctly self-banish on activation. Verified live: the card remains on the field after activating, and the ability has no cost at all. Flagged separately as task_f3f78343; this fixture asserts the actual (buggy) observed behavior. The opponent's optional follow-up (may materialize a card from their material deck) is declined via a trailing NO from player 2.

rulesClauses: Banish CARDNAME: Draw a card. Then target opponent may materialize a card from their material deck.
